name: QuickFIX Appliance Repair
demoLabel: Supervised pilot — requests require confirmation from QuickFIX.
privacyText: QuickFIX uses MendCue to collect your appliance problem, contact details and optional photos for its service team. Drafts expire after 7 days; closed requests after 90 days. Submit only details needed for your repair. A request does not confirm a booking or quote.
openingMessage: I'm QuickFIX’s AI intake assistant, powered by MendCue. Tell me what’s wrong with your appliance. I’ll collect the details and prepare a summary for the repairman. You can ask for a person at any time.
gasUtilityContact: Leave the area and contact your gas utility or emergency services from a safe location.
